title: Future Juice Cherry Bakewell Cheesecake  Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Cherry Bakewell Cheesecake is a decadent dessert blend that combines the sweet, tart flavour of ripe Cherries with the creamy indulgence of Cheesecake and the unmistakable sugary notes of a classic Bakewell Tart. The juicy Cherry filling brings a hint of fruitiness, complemented by the smooth richness of Cheesecake. A buttery Pastry and Almond base rounds out the profile, delivering a warm and nutty depth with every puff. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense clouds and layered flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it offers a satisfying dessert-inspired vape. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
